definitions.ask: Cap a rewritten Tasks section's trailing gap at one blank line (vs. only discounting a dropped group's separator)?
definitions.why: Matches the emitter's internal blank-run collapse and self-heals the vault

choices.label: Stops growth and heals inflated notes on next reconcile; deliberate 2+ blank gaps get normalized
Keeps deliberate multi-blank gaps; already-inflated notes never heal and need manual cleanup

definitions.ask: Should the coder also hand-trim the extra blank lines in the live ~/bob notes now?
definitions.why: The fix heals these notes itself; agent edits to the live vault risk sync conflicts

choices.label: Vault untouched; the first reconcile by the fixed bob on each host heals the gaps
Coder trims the 8 inflated notes now; gaps regrow nightly until the release reaches hosts
